title: I was worried people would call my first game “AI slop.” I put the demo on Steam yesterday, and I’m proud of it
author: jcreid
selftext:
I’ve been working on *We Will Die For You* since July. I’ve been hesitant to talk about how much I used AI because I figured some people would call it “AI slop” before they even played it. Honestly, I don’t care anymore. I think I made a pretty awesome game, and I want to share it.

You play as a white blood cell. You break up debris and collect Protein until your cell runs out of energy. When it dies, you spend that Protein on upgrades and abilities that help the next cell take on tougher enemies and bosses.

AI helped me in just about every area of the game. The best way I can explain it is that AI was my employee. The ideas and direction were mine. AI did most of the coding, which I couldn’t have done on my own, and helped with the art, writing and sound too.

One example is the one of the skins in the game, Bruised Cell. It's in the video I attached. I wanted one little purple spot that would spread across the cell over the course of a run. After a few tries, we got it to spread a little each time the cell squeezes. I could picture that long before I knew how to make it happen, but AI knew how to do it.

If you give the demo a shot, I’d love you to leave a review and let me know your thoughts.

[Play the free demo on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5407980/We_Will_Die_For_You_Demo/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=demo_launch_2026_11_23&utm_content=aigamedev_first_game) · [Watch the trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j3Ef6tNFmrk)

comments.author: Xinnobun
